CONVERSATION.NAME: Lay off me, Claire!
CONVERSATION.DESCRIP: You're sorry she's hurt, but you had nothing to do with it. Being a mega-bitch isn't going to help her be happy again. If she really still cares about Justin, maybe she should let him be with the person who makes him happy – you.

CARD.NAME: Crazy stalker much?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Um, crazy stalker much?

CARD.NAME: Do you really think Justin will find this attractive?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Do you really think Justin will find this attractive? You just seem insane.

CARD.NAME: I heard you used to be nice
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I heard you used to be a nice person. Did you fall and break your brain or something?

CARD.NAME: I make him laugh.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I make him laugh. Laughter is the best medicine.

CARD.NAME: I'm embarrassed for you
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I'm embarrassed for you. Aren't you just a little bit ashamed of yourself? (Makes all your embarrassing dialog stronger).
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: +1 to all my cards of embarassed,

CARD.NAME: I'm sorry that bad things happened to you but...
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I'm sorry that bad things happened to you but that doesn't mean you get to be evil to everyone.

CARD.NAME: If you really cared about Justin
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If you really cared about Justin, you wouldn't stand in the way of his happiness with me.

CARD.NAME: Justin is over you
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Justin is over you. Get that through your psycho skull.

CARD.NAME: Lay off me, Claire!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Lay off me, Claire! Your problems are NOT my fault.

CARD.NAME: Move on!
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Move on, you crazy bitch! Hanging onto the past just makes you seem pathetic.

CARD.NAME: Ugly on the inside
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You may think you're gorgeous, but your heart is so ugly, that's all anyone can see.

CARD.NAME: Yawn.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Yaaawwwwn! I'm sorry - were you bitching about something again?

CARD.NAME: You are obviously unhinged
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You are obviously unhinged. Justin doesn't need that in his life right now.

CARD.NAME: You must be threatened
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If you're wasting so much time on me, you must be feeling pretty threatened.

CARD.NAME: You're not doing yourself any favors.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Being a mega-bitch is not going to win you anyone's favor.

CARD.NAME: Even my chihuahua thinks you're a nothing
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Even my chihuahua thinks you're nothing. He's not even bothering to acknowledge your presence.

CARD.NAME: Everyone thinks you're pathetic
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Everyone thinks you're totally pathetic, chasing Justin around like that.

CARD.NAME: He doesn't care about you.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Justin doesn't care about you. He just thinks you're an easy hook-up.

CARD.NAME: He'll hurt you.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: He'll hurt you. Just like he did Stefanie.

CARD.NAME: I don't care what you say
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I don't care what you say - it's totally obvious that Justin still loves me.

CARD.NAME: I'm doing you a favor
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I'm doing you a favor by telling you he's not interested. Not my fault if you're too dumb to take the hint.

CARD.NAME: I'm the only one is this town who's telling you the truth
CARD.DESCRIPTION: I'm the only one is this town who's telling you the truth - you have ZERO chance with Justin.

CARD.NAME: If you don't stay away from Justin
CARD.DESCRIPTION: If you don't stay away from Justin, I'll tell everyone you made a pass at me.

CARD.NAME: It's not like Justin meant that much to me
CARD.DESCRIPTION: It's not like Justin meant that much to me, so why would I care if you chase after him?

CARD.NAME: No one will even give you the time of day
CARD.DESCRIPTION: No one will even give you the time of day if I tell them not to. Not even Justin.

CARD.NAME: The only reason I'm wasting any time on you...
CARD.DESCRIPTION: The only reason I'm wasting any time on you is that I have a soft spot for dumb little animals.

CARD.NAME: What was that again?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: What was that again? I'm sorry - I don't speak "Loser".

CARD.NAME: You don't actually interest him
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You don't actually interest him. You're just an easy distraction. (All cards that make Claire less unsure are stronger)
CARD.EFFECT_DESCRIBED: -1 to all my cards of unsure,

CARD.NAME: You have nothing to offer
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You have nothing to offer Justin, and he's too polite to tell you you're BORING. Everyone says so.

CARD.NAME: You think you make him laugh?
CARD.DESCRIPTION: You think you make him laugh? That would be AT, loser. Not WITH.
